purpose: Verify authenticated users can browse published catalogue entries and unpublished entries are hidden.
preconditions: User is authenticated. Catalogue contains both published and unpublished entries.
action_or_input: User requests to browse the scholarship and award catalogue.
expected_result: System displays only the currently published catalogue entries.

purpose: Verify system displays all required details for a published catalogue entry.
preconditions: A scholarship catalogue entry is published with description, eligibility, evidence, dates, and renewal info.
action_or_input: User views the published catalogue entry details.
expected_result: System displays the description, eligibility criteria, required evidence, application method, dates, and renewal information.

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can create a new draft catalogue entry.
preconditions: User is logged in as SPACS Convener.
action_or_input: Convener initiates creation of a new scholarship catalogue entry.
expected_result: System creates a new draft catalogue entry.

purpose: Verify Convener can modify a draft without altering historical versions used by existing applications.
preconditions: A published catalogue version exists and is linked to an existing application. A new draft version is created.
action_or_input: Convener modifies the draft catalogue version.
expected_result: The draft is updated, but the historical version linked to the existing application remains unaltered.

purpose: Verify system blocks publication of a catalogue version if policy-approval reference or effective dates are missing.
preconditions: User is SPACS Convener. A draft catalogue entry is missing the policy-approval reference or effective dates.
action_or_input: Convener attempts to publish/activate the draft catalogue version.
expected_result: System blocks the publication and displays an error indicating missing policy approval or dates.

purpose: Verify Convener can retire a catalogue entry prospectively while preserving historical applications.
preconditions: A published catalogue entry exists with historical applications governed by it.
action_or_input: Convener retires/deactivates the catalogue entry.
expected_result: The entry is retired prospectively. Historical applications and policy versions remain preserved and accessible.

purpose: Verify system preserves an auditable version history of catalogue criteria and publication status.
preconditions: A catalogue entry has undergone multiple modifications and publications over time.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests the version history of the catalogue entry.
expected_result: System displays the complete auditable version history including criteria, rules, dates, publication status, and effective periods.

purpose: Verify system blocks a student from starting an application if the scheme's application window is closed.
preconditions: A scholarship scheme is published but its application window is currently closed.
action_or_input: Student attempts to start a new application for the closed scheme.
expected_result: System blocks the application initiation and indicates the window is closed.

purpose: Verify system blocks submission if machine-checkable eligibility criteria are not satisfied.
preconditions: Student has an in-progress application. A mandatory machine-checkable eligibility criterion is not met.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit the application.
expected_result: System blocks the submission and indicates the unmet eligibility criterion.

purpose: Verify system prevents duplicate active/submitted applications for the same student, scholarship, and cycle.
preconditions: Student already has an active or submitted application for a specific scholarship and academic cycle.
action_or_input: Student attempts to create another application for the same scholarship and cycle.
expected_result: System blocks the creation of the duplicate application.

purpose: Verify student can enter all application data required by the selected scholarship version.
preconditions: Student has started an application for a published scholarship.
action_or_input: Student enters data into all required fields defined by the scholarship version.
expected_result: System accepts and saves the entered application data.

purpose: Verify student can upload supporting documents required by the scholarship.
preconditions: Student is in an editable application state.
action_or_input: Student uploads a valid supporting document.
expected_result: System accepts the upload and associates the document with the application.

purpose: Verify system offers previously uploaded documents for reuse only when they are still valid and satisfy requirements.
preconditions: Student has a previously uploaded document that is expired or does not satisfy the current scheme's requirement.
action_or_input: Student views the document reuse options for the current application.
expected_result: System does not offer the expired/non-compliant document for reuse.

purpose: Verify system allows explicit draft saving and preserves input on recoverable timeout/error.
preconditions: Student is entering application data.
action_or_input: Student explicitly saves the draft, then a simulated recoverable timeout occurs.
expected_result: System preserves the recoverable application input and allows the student to resume.

purpose: Verify system blocks submission if mandatory fields or required documents are missing.
preconditions: Student has an in-progress application with missing mandatory fields or documents.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit the application.
expected_result: System blocks submission and prompts for the missing mandatory fields or documents.

purpose: Verify system assigns unique ID, timestamp, and policy version on successful submission.
preconditions: Student has completed a valid application ready for submission.
action_or_input: Student submits the application.
expected_result: System assigns a unique application identifier, records the submission timestamp, and binds it to the applicable catalogue/policy version.

purpose: Verify system changes state to Submitted and routes verification task to SPACS Assistant on submission.
preconditions: Application is successfully submitted.
action_or_input: System processes the successful submission.
expected_result: Application state changes to Submitted and a verification task is created and routed to the SPACS Assistant role.

purpose: Verify system notifies student and SPACS Assistant upon successful submission.
preconditions: Application is successfully submitted.
action_or_input: System triggers submission notifications.
expected_result: Student receives a successful submission notification, and the responsible SPACS Assistant receives a notification of a new application requiring verification.

purpose: Verify authorized SPACS Assistant can access assigned applications and evidence.
preconditions: An application is routed to the SPACS Assistant for verification.
action_or_input: SPACS Assistant attempts to access the assigned application and its supporting evidence.
expected_result: System grants access to the application details and uploaded evidence.

purpose: Verify SPACS Assistant can record verification findings without granting final sanction authority.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant is reviewing an assigned application.
action_or_input: Assistant records completeness and eligibility findings.
expected_result: System saves the verification findings. The Assistant interface does not provide options for final scholarship approval/rejection.

purpose: Verify SPACS Assistant can return an application to the student for correction with a recorded reason.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant identifies missing or invalid evidence during verification.
action_or_input: Assistant returns the application to the student and provides a correction reason.
expected_result: System updates the application state to Correction Required, notifies the student, and records the reason.

purpose: Verify student can modify and resubmit an application in Correction Required state.
preconditions: Application is in Correction Required state.
action_or_input: Student modifies the required information and resubmits the application.
expected_result: System accepts the modifications and resubmission, updating the application state accordingly.

purpose: Verify system revalidates a corrected resubmission and invalidates prior verification if applicable.
preconditions: Student resubmits an application after correction, changing data that affects prior verification.
action_or_input: System processes the resubmission.
expected_result: System revalidates the changed application and clears/invalidates any prior verification decisions that are no longer applicable.

purpose: Verify SPACS Assistant can mark an application Verified and route it to the SPACS Convener.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant has completed verification and all requirements are satisfied.
action_or_input: Assistant marks the application as Verified.
expected_result: System updates the application status to Verified and routes it to the SPACS Convener for decision.

purpose: Verify SPACS Assistant can record an unresolved verification concern and route it appropriately.
preconditions: SPACS Assistant identifies an unresolved verification concern (e.g., suspected ineligibility).
action_or_input: Assistant records the concern and routes it according to the scheme workflow.
expected_result: System records the concern and routes the application to the SPACS Convener for final decision or returns it for correction as configured.

purpose: Verify system issues reminders/escalations when verification or decision tasks exceed SLA thresholds.
preconditions: A verification or decision task has been pending beyond its configured SLA threshold.
action_or_input: System SLA monitoring job executes.
expected_result: System issues configured reminder or escalation notifications to the responsible role.

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can review applications routed for decision with verification and policy context.
preconditions: An application is routed to the SPACS Convener for decision.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener opens the application for review.
expected_result: System displays the application data, verification findings, and the applicable policy context.

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can approve, reject, or return a scholarship application for correction.
preconditions: SPACS Convener is reviewing a verified application.
action_or_input: Convener selects an outcome (approve, reject, or return for correction).
expected_result: System records the selected outcome and transitions the application to the corresponding state.

purpose: Verify system records decision outcome, actor, timestamp, policy version, and reason.
preconditions: SPACS Convener makes a decision on an application.
action_or_input: System processes the decision action.
expected_result: System persists the decision outcome, decision actor, timestamp, applicable policy version, and decision reason.

purpose: Verify system updates application state and notifies student of the decision outcome.
preconditions: A scholarship decision has been recorded.
action_or_input: System finalizes the decision workflow.
expected_result: Application state is updated to the resulting state (e.g., Approved, Rejected), and the student is notified of the outcome.

purpose: Verify system blocks student from modifying an application in a non-editable lifecycle state.
preconditions: Application is in a final or non-editable state (e.g., Approved or Rejected).
action_or_input: Student attempts to modify the application.
expected_result: System blocks the modification and indicates the application is not in an editable state.

purpose: Verify system revalidates and reroutes/reverifies an application after a permitted modification that invalidates prior processing.
preconditions: Student modifies an application in an editable state, changing data that affects eligibility or assignment.
action_or_input: System saves the modification.
expected_result: System revalidates the application and reroutes/reverifies it as required by the scheme workflow.

purpose: Verify system blocks student from withdrawing an application after a final decision is made.
preconditions: Application has reached a final decision state (e.g., Approved).
action_or_input: Student attempts to withdraw the application.
expected_result: System blocks the withdrawal and indicates it is no longer withdrawable.

purpose: Verify system records withdrawal, closes tasks, sets state to Withdrawn, and notifies parties.
preconditions: Application is in a withdrawable state before final decision.
action_or_input: Student withdraws the application.
expected_result: System records the withdrawal, closes pending tasks, sets state to Withdrawn, retains audit history, and notifies relevant parties.

purpose: Verify student can view current state and relevant status history of their own applications.
preconditions: Student has multiple applications with various status changes.
action_or_input: Student views their scholarship dashboard.
expected_result: System displays the current state and relevant status history for each of the student's applications.

purpose: Verify staff export is restricted to authorized roles and denied for unauthorized staff.
preconditions: User is logged in as a staff member without export authorization.
action_or_input: Staff member attempts to export application data.
expected_result: System denies the export request and restricts access to authorized roles only.

purpose: Verify system identifies an awarded scholarship as renewal-eligible only when policy and window permit.
preconditions: A scholarship is awarded, but the renewal window is currently closed or policy does not permit renewal.
action_or_input: System evaluates the awarded scholarship for renewal eligibility.
expected_result: System does not identify the scholarship as renewal-eligible.

purpose: Verify student can start a renewal application with prefilled reusable data and identified refreshed evidence.
preconditions: Scholarship is renewal-eligible and within the renewal window.
action_or_input: Student initiates the renewal application.
expected_result: System prefills reusable prior data and clearly identifies information/evidence that must be refreshed.

purpose: Verify system validates renewal-specific eligibility and updated evidence according to active policy.
preconditions: Student submits a renewal application with invalid or missing updated evidence.
action_or_input: Student attempts to submit the renewal application.
expected_result: System blocks submission and indicates the renewal-specific eligibility or evidence validation failure.

purpose: Verify system routes a submitted renewal through verification and fresh decision rather than auto-approving.
preconditions: Student successfully submits a valid renewal application.
action_or_input: System processes the renewal submission.
expected_result: System routes the renewal through the standard verification and fresh scholarship decision workflow; it is not automatically approved.

purpose: Verify system sends configured renewal reminders to eligible students before the deadline.
preconditions: A student is eligible for renewal and the configured reminder date is reached.
action_or_input: System renewal reminder job executes.
expected_result: System sends configured renewal reminders to the eligible student.

purpose: Verify system supports the configured candidate-source method for an activated award scheme.
preconditions: An award scheme is activated with a specific candidate-source method (e.g., system-generated, nomination).
action_or_input: System initializes the award cycle.
expected_result: System obtains candidate records using the configured candidate-source method.

purpose: Verify SPACS Convener can prepare and finalize the candidate pool using policy and authoritative data.
preconditions: Award cycle is active and candidate records are available.
action_or_input: SPACS Convener prepares and finalizes the candidate pool.
expected_result: System allows the Convener to finalize the pool based on the applicable policy version and authoritative data.

purpose: Verify authorized Award Evaluation Committee members can access candidate info and record evaluations.
preconditions: Committee members are assigned to an award cycle.
action_or_input: Committee member accesses candidate information and records shortlist/evaluation recommendations.
expected_result: System grants access and saves the evaluation/recommendation information required by the award policy.

purpose: Verify system records final award approval/decision outcome and approving authority/reference.
preconditions: Committee has made a recommendation/decision.
action_or_input: Authorized authority records the final award approval outcome and reference.
expected_result: System records the final award decision outcome and the approving authority/reference according to the policy.

purpose: Verify system blocks publication of award results before the required final approval is recorded.
preconditions: Award evaluation is complete, but final approval outcome is not yet recorded.
action_or_input: Authorized user attempts to publish/announce the award results.
expected_result: System blocks the publication and indicates that final approval must be recorded first.

purpose: Verify system preserves candidate list, evaluation records, recommendations, and publication history.
preconditions: An award cycle has completed evaluation, approval, and publication.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests the award cycle history.
expected_result: System displays the preserved candidate list, evaluation records, recommendations, approval references, and publication history.

purpose: Verify system sends configured email and in-dashboard notifications for significant lifecycle events.
preconditions: Notifications are configured for a significant lifecycle event (e.g., submission, decision).
action_or_input: The lifecycle event occurs.
expected_result: System sends the configured email and in-dashboard notifications to the affected student and/or authorized role.

purpose: Verify system creates time-stamped audit records for significant SPACS actions.
preconditions: A significant action (e.g., submission, verification, decision) occurs.
action_or_input: System processes the significant action.
expected_result: System creates a time-stamped audit record for the action.

purpose: Verify system protects audit records from ordinary modification and restricts access to authorized personnel.
preconditions: User is logged in as an unauthorized staff member.
action_or_input: User attempts to view or modify the audit log.
expected_result: System denies access to the audit log and prevents modification.

purpose: Verify system enforces role- and ownership-based access to protected functions.
preconditions: User is logged in with a role that lacks ownership or specific authorization for a protected function (e.g., verifying another's application).
action_or_input: User attempts to execute the protected function.
expected_result: System denies access and enforces the role/ownership constraint.

purpose: Verify system routes uncompleted tasks to the new role holder on reassignment while preserving historical actor identity.
preconditions: A SPACS role holder has uncompleted tasks. The role assignment is changed to a new user.
action_or_input: System processes the role reassignment.
expected_result: System routes the uncompleted tasks to the newly assigned role holder. Historical audit records retain the original actor's identity for completed actions.
